author: Huawei
description:
The museum experience is being digitized. Manetho, an AI-powered cultural heritage digitization system, uses computer vision and NLP to translate hieroglyphs in real time. The solution turns artifacts into interactive learning tools.

Built with #Huawei Cloud, ModelArts, and MindSpore, Manetho helps tourists, students, researchers, and museums gain better access and a deeper understanding of Egyptian history. It shows how teams at the Huawei #ICTCompetition 2025–2026 Global Final develop solutions that deliver sustained cultural value by unlocking the past with modern innovations.

The Huawei ICT Competition is an international platform for competition and exchange, enabling students and teachers to strengthen ICT knowledge and skills, and foster innovation. Discover more: https://bit.ly/49PSMsc #ICTheFuture
title: Manetho: AI-Powered Hieroglyphic Translation for Museums
